27: type CommentType = keyof typeof commentPatterns;

29: export type MagicCommentConfig = {
30:   className: string;
31:   line?: string;
32:   block?: {start: string; end: string};
33: };

35: function getCommentPattern(
36:   languages: CommentType[],
37:   magicCommentDirectives: MagicCommentConfig[],
38: ) {
39:   // To be more reliable, the opening and closing comment must match
40:   const commentPattern = languages
41:     .map((lang) => {
42:       const {start, end} = commentPatterns[lang];
43:       return `(?:${start}\\s*(${magicCommentDirectives
44:         .flatMap((d) => [d.line, d.block?.start, d.block?.end].filter(Boolean))
45:         .join('|')})\\s*${end})`;
46:     })
47:     .join('|');
48:   // White space is allowed, but otherwise it should be on it's own line
49:   return new RegExp(`^\\s*(?:${commentPattern})\\s*$`);
50: }

52: /**
53:  * Select comment styles based on language
54:  */
55: function getAllMagicCommentDirectiveStyles(
56:   lang: string,
57:   magicCommentDirectives: MagicCommentConfig[],
58: ) {
59:   switch (lang) {
60:     case 'js':
61:     case 'javascript':
62:     case 'ts':
63:     case 'typescript':

76:         magicCommentDirectives,
77:       );

242:     }
243:     lines.splice(lineNumber, 1);

250:       lineClassNames[l]!.push(className);
251:     });
